decisions.reason: The low-noise burner remains a differentiated option with uncertain but potentially valuable prospects, and keeping it on the market costs little while the firm holds multiple other options.
Having its own product page indicates a stronger initial commitment, and the plaque heater is kept as a still-open option with low keeping costs and unresolved upside.
The luminous radiant heater is a niche option whose prospects remain uncertain, and because keeping costs are low the firm retains the option.
The tube heater is mentioned but not featured, yet it still holds unresolved market value as an option and is inexpensive to keep.
The standard plaque heater has its own page, suggesting a more established option worth keeping while uncertainty about its future value persists.

This tube heater shows less evidence of commitment and may overlap with product D, so its drop probability is slightly higher, but the option is still kept due to low costs and unresolved uncertainty.
